entries.name: oracle_events
entries.description: Replace fixture extraction with frozen canonical truth events.
entries.finding: Fixture replay gives the same gap metrics as oracle events in this run; no extraction loss is observable.

entries.name: no_evidence_gate
entries.description: Use candidate gaps directly instead of requiring evidence verification.
entries.finding: The evidence gate removed no benchmark gap in this fixture run; its value is trust/auditability, not measured F1 gain here.
entries.limitation: Candidate output does not satisfy the trust gates for displayed care gaps.

entries.name: no_secondary_priority_cap
entries.description: Raise the secondary-gap bonus cap from 0.30 to 1.00.
entries.finding: Removing the secondary cap does not change the Top-5 in this panel.
entries.limitation: Single fixed panel; not evidence of population-level ranking stability.

unmeasured.name: no_normalization
unmeasured.reason: The frozen extraction store has already been normalized; a faithful raw-entity ablation requires a new extraction run.

unmeasured.name: no_reconciliation
unmeasured.reason: Reconciliation is embedded in the frozen extraction artifact; disabling it requires regenerating canonical events.

unmeasured.name: no_negative_safeguards
unmeasured.reason: Detector safeguard flags are not exposed as a supported runtime configuration.

unmeasured.name: no_grounding_claim_filter
unmeasured.reason: The evidence gate and claim-coverage filter are the same architecture boundary; no separate observable was produced.
